Body.Content:
Public APIs for the Import tasks capability enable customers and partners to programmatically import tasks from one project into another. Organizations can call these APIs from custom applications, integrations, or automated workflows instead of requiring a user to initiate each import manually.

The APIs support repeatable project-creation and planning scenarios, such as populating new projects with tasks from templates or previously completed projects. Customers can incorporate task imports into their existing project provisioning and automation processes.

GA date: October CY2026
